science.description: Active investigation or development-only behavior. Not advertised in release example config.

dormant.description: Retained historical or compatibility code that must not be runtime-installed.

internal.description: Implementation plumbing or shared fan-out, not a user-facing feature surface.

hook_modules.rationale: Central frame fan-out for registered subscribers.
Release-supported hotkey and contextual action behavior.
Kir'Shara queue investigation detours are force-disabled after native queue behavior changed.
Release-supported opt-in diagnostic breadcrumbs with explicit config gating.
Shared section-change fan-out for feature modules.

config_surfaces.rationale: Dormant Kir'Shara marker diagnostics are retained for history and future investigation only.
Dormant Kir'Shara queue repair config must not be advertised as release-supported.
Legacy queue-add experiment keys remain isolated from normal release example config.

promotion_process.summary: Promotion from science or dormant to production requires explicit manifest change, runtime evidence, release config review, and validation.
required_evidence: updated hook/module tier and rationale in this manifest
runtime smoke on a production build or a documented reason why runtime validation is not applicable
release example config change only after the tier is production
AXF review contract passing after the promotion
